contract: Complete source-level transformer block versus a benchmark-only MPSGraph control.
model: Bias-free single-head unmasked pre-RMSNorm encoder; separate Q/K/V and output projections; attention softmax; two residuals; explicit epsilon and scale; unit RMS gain; 4x ReLU FFN. No KV cache, masks, tokenizer or generation.
timing: Warm synchronous tensor-result API, complete device ACK and invocation cleanup; no output readback in timing on either GPU. Pipeline/graph preparation excluded. Mode 0 all resident; mode 1 activation upload; mode 2 all seven inputs uploaded per call. CPU includes native invocation ownership cleanup. Fresh processes, two warmup batches, three measured batches, reversed CPU/GPU/MPS/MPS/GPU/CPU orders; implementation-specific calibrated counts avoid huge duration skew.
